response.sql:
WITH team_totals AS (
    SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games
    FROM home_game
    GROUP BY team_id
),
summary AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_home_games) AS avg_home_games,
           SUM(total_home_games) AS all_home_games
    FROM team_totals
)
SELECT t.team_id,
       t.total_home_games,
       1.0 * t.total_home_games / s.all_home_games AS share_of_all_home_games,
       1.0 * t.total_home_games / s.avg_home_games AS ratio_to_average
FROM team_totals AS t
CROSS JOIN summary AS s
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average is across team IDs in home_game after summing their records; SUM and AVG ignore missing games values. Team IDs with no home_game records are not included.

alternatives.interpretation: Average across team-year totals instead, combining records for each team and year before computing the average; each team’s reported total and share still cover all years.
